channel.title: Charta updates
channel.description: Dated changes to Charta: rules, launch, tests and website.

item.title: Holder map, Verify page and this update log
item.description: The home page now shows a live bubble map of every CHTA holder with lines for direct transfers between wallets. A new Verify page checks the program code, its upgrade key, the mint and the vaults straight from the chain.

item.title: How-to guide, risks page and a new look
item.description: A step-by-step guide to the opening auction, twelve risks stated plainly, and a redesigned site with self-hosted fonts.

item.title: Auction and Live data pages
item.description: The opening auction page shows every bid live from the chain; the Live data page shows supply, treasury, expenses and the price reference.

item.title: Charta logo and token metadata
item.description: The column inside a flat-cut C. The token metadata file used by wallets is published on this site.

item.title: Version 23: launch parameters
item.description: Opening auction minimum price 0.0002 USDC; project floor 120 USDC; a protected fixed technical cost of 12 USDC per rolling 30 days. Other spending stays limited to 25% a year of the reserve.

item.title: Attack tests: 93 attacks, all blocked
item.description: 61 attacks by outsiders and a malicious administrator, then 32 attacks by outsiders only, against the compiled program in a local simulator. All were blocked. These are the project's own tests, not an independent audit.

item.title: New name: Charta (CHTA)
item.description: The token formerly called HELI is now Charta, symbol CHTA.

item.title: At most 250,000 CHTA per wallet in the auction
item.description: One wallet may bid for at most 5% of the 5 million CHTA offered.

item.title: No free allocation
item.description: The whole 5 million CHTA launch base goes through one open auction and the market. No presale, no private round.

item.title: Team trading commitment
item.description: The founder and team trade CHTA only from publicly declared wallets.
